final: WITH c AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), s AS (SELECT arcref, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c) SELECT arcref, cnt AS qc_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS deviation FROM s ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST, arcref LIMIT 10
